src/.main.jsx: React app entry point; mounts root and providers
src/.App.jsx: Root router; lazy-loads portal bundles by role prefix

styles/.tokens.css: CSS custom properties for all design tokens (colour, typography, spacing, radius, elevation)
styles/.global.css: Reset, base html/body styles, font-face declarations
styles/.utilities.css: Atomic utility classes derived from spacing and colour tokens

config/.env.js: Reads and exports VITE_ environment variables
config/.routes.js: Centralised route path constants matching routes.json
config/.roles.js: Role name constants and RBAC helper maps

types/.user.types.js: JSDoc/PropTypes definitions for User, Customer, Address

utils/.formatCurrency.js: Formats numeric values to locale currency strings
utils/.orderStatus.js: Order status transition helpers and label maps
utils/.errorMessages.js: Human-readable error code to message mapping

hooks/.useAuth.js: Reads auth context; returns user, token, role helpers
hooks/.useCart.js: Cart state accessor and mutation helpers
hooks/.useGeolocation.js: Wraps browser Geolocation API with permission state
hooks/.useSocket.js: Initialises and returns Socket.IO connection for real-time events
hooks/.useDebounce.js: Generic debounce hook used in search inputs
hooks/.usePagination.js: Cursor/page state management for list views
hooks/.useNotifications.js: Subscribes to notification events and manages badge count

context/.AuthContext.jsx: JWT token, decoded user, login/logout; provides auth state app-wide
context/.CartContext.jsx: Active cart document, item mutations, totals recalculation
context/.NotificationContext.jsx: In-app notification queue and read state
context/.SocketContext.jsx: Singleton Socket.IO instance shared across components

services/.api.js: Axios instance with base URL, JWT interceptor, and error normaliser
services/.authService.js: register, login, logout, verifyEmail, forgotPassword, resetPassword
services/.userService.js: getProfile, updateProfile, listAddresses, createAddress, updateAddress, deleteAddress
services/.menuService.js: listCategories, getItem, createCategory, updateCategory, deleteCategory, createItem, updateItem, deleteItem, toggleItemAvailability
services/.deliveryService.js: getDelivery, updateLocation, acceptJob, declineJob, markDelivered, uploadProof, listDeliveryHistory
services/.adminService.js: onboardRestaurant, suspendRestaurant, reactivateRestaurant, onboardAgent, suspendAgent, listUsers, getUser, listOrders, listTransactions, listDisputes, resolveDispute, moderateReview, getPlatformConfig, updatePlatformConfig

Button/.Button.jsx: Primary, secondary, ghost, destructive variants; enforces 44px min tap target

Input/.Input.jsx: Text, email, tel, password input with inline error display

Modal/.Modal.jsx: Accessible dialog with backdrop; radius-lg, elevation-2

Card/.Card.jsx: Surface card with elevation-1, radius-md, optional hero image slot

Badge/.Badge.jsx: Pill badge for status labels; uses color-secondary or status colours

Avatar/.Avatar.jsx: User or restaurant avatar with radius-pill fallback initials

EmptyState/.EmptyState.jsx: Illustration and message for empty list views

ErrorMessage/.ErrorMessage.jsx: Inline field or page-level error using color-error

AppShell/.AppShell.jsx: Wraps page with TopNav, optional BottomNav, and canvas background

TopNav/.TopNav.jsx: Consistent top navigation bar with logo, account link, and help

Sidebar/.Sidebar.jsx: Desktop left-side navigation for restaurant portal and admin console
